sections.label: Infrastructure & Utilities

sections.label: Street Trees & Landscaping

comments.headline: Missing building elevation sheets and clearance documentation
comments.summary: Building elevation sheets required to verify clearances from buildings and projections to overhead electric conductors are entirely absent from the 39-sheet site plan submittal. No clearance dimensions for required 7'6" sky-to-ground clearance or 15-foot radial clearance are documented.
comments.crossDep: Coordinate with Architecture for building elevation sheets; coordinate with Civil Engineering if grade changes affect clearances.
comments.attn: Building elevation sheets are required deliverables and must be submitted with dimension annotations from buildings and projections to OHE conductors before clearance verification can be assessed.

details.text: Building clearances from overhead electric conductors cannot be verified. No horizontal clearance dimensions from conductor to building faces provided, and no elevation sheets document required 7-foot 6-inch sky-to-ground clearance.

runComments.comment: Building clearances from overhead electric conductors cannot be verified. While OHE lines are shown on the site plan along property boundaries where buildings are proposed, no horizontal clearance dimensions are provided from the outside conductors to any building faces. No building elevation sheets are included in the submittal to demonstrate compliance with the required 7-foot 6-inch sky-to-ground clearance.

details.text: Customer facilities (buildings) do not demonstrate compliance with 15-foot radial clearance from outside conductor of overhead distribution conductors. No clearance dimension annotations provided on site plan or in building elevation documentation.

runComments.comment: Customer facilities (buildings) do not demonstrate compliance with 15-foot radial clearance from outside conductor of overhead distribution conductors. No clearance dimension annotations are provided on site plan or in building elevation documentation.

details.text: Building projections (overhangs, awnings, balconies, roofs) are not documented with clearance verification. No building elevation sheets provided in submittal to show spatial relationship between projections and overhead electric conductors.

runComments.comment: Building projections (overhangs, awnings, balconies, roofs) are not documented with clearance verification. No building elevation sheets are provided in the submittal to show the spatial relationship between any building projections and overhead electric conductors.

details.text: Buildings proposed adjacent to Valley View Road (west property line) where overhead electric lines exist in right-of-way. Clearances from buildings to ROW-located overhead facilities not documented with dimension annotations or elevation data.

runComments.comment: Buildings are proposed adjacent to Valley View Road (west property line) where overhead electric lines exist in the right-of-way per the existing conditions survey. Clearances from buildings to the ROW-located overhead facilities are not documented with dimension annotations or elevation data.

details.text: No building elevation sheets included in site plan submittal. Surveyed elevations and locations of overhead electric conductors cannot be verified because building elevation sheets, which typically document this information, are absent from 39-sheet set.

runComments.comment: No building elevation sheets are included in the site plan submittal. Surveyed elevations and locations of overhead electric conductors cannot be verified because building elevation sheets, which typically document this information, are absent from the 39-sheet set.

comments.headline: Missing clearance dimension annotations and surveyor verification data
comments.summary: Horizontal and vertical clearance dimension annotations are completely absent from all site plans. Clearance measurements are not taken from the outside conductor as required by code, and no registered surveyor data documents pole locations or mid-span clearances.
comments.crossDep: Coordinate with Surveying profession for registered surveyor data on pole locations, mid-span clearances, and conductor elevations.
comments.attn: UCM § 1.10.3 requires all clearance measurements taken from the outside conductor, not from pole centerlines or structures. Provide dimension annotations originating from conductor location on all relevant plans (site, grading, architectural sections). Surveyor certification required for pole locations and clearance verification.

details.text: Section and plan view exhibits showing clearance dimensions from outer electric conductor to outermost edges of buildings are not provided. Site plan shows OHE lines and building layouts but contains no dimension annotations measuring clearances from conductor to any building face or projection.

runComments.comment: Section and plan view exhibits showing clearance dimensions from outer electric conductor to outermost edges of buildings are not provided. The site plan shows OHE lines and building layouts but contains no dimension annotations measuring clearances from the conductor to any building face or projection.

details.text: No clearance dimension annotations provided on site plans. Critically, OHE lines are marked but no dimension lines originate from outside conductor location. Code requires measurements from conductor, not pole centerlines. Complete absence of clearance dimensions prevents assessment of whether any existing dimensions comply correctly.

runComments.comment: No clearance dimension annotations are provided on the site plans. Critically, the OHE lines are marked but no dimension lines originate from the outside conductor location. The code requirement mandates that all clearance measurements be taken from the outside conductor, not from utility pole centerlines or structures. The complete absence of clearance dimensions prevents assessment of whether any dimensions that might exist are measured correctly.

details.text: Surveyed elevations and locations of overhead electric conductors cannot be verified because building elevation sheets are absent. No survey data from registered surveyor showing pole locations and mid-span clearances provided to establish vertical clearance compliance for buildings and driveways.

runComments.comment: Proposed site features (buildings and driveways) are located in proximity to the OHE line. Without documented conductor elevations and site feature elevations with comparison analysis, vertical clearance compliance appears marginal or unverifiable. No survey data from a registered surveyor showing pole locations and mid-span clearances is provided.

comments.headline: Missing vertical clearance documentation for driveways and retaining walls
comments.summary: Driveways and retaining walls lack vertical clearance documentation from overhead electric lines. Section views and elevation data showing clearances at all points (especially mid-span for driveways) and between wall faces and OHE conductors are missing.
comments.crossDep: Coordinate with Civil Engineering (driveways and grading) and Structural Engineering (retaining walls) for elevation documentation and clearance verification.
comments.attn: Driveway sections must show lowest point of OHE line including attachments and compare to finished driveway grade at all points, especially mid-span. Retaining wall sections must include OHE conductor elevations and clearance dimension annotations from outer conductor to wall faces.

details.text: Retaining walls proposed and shown on site plan and wall detail sheets. Clearance distances from outermost edge of retaining walls to outside conductor of overhead electric line not documented with dimension annotations on plan sheets.

runComments.comment: Retaining walls are proposed and shown on site plan and wall detail sheets. However, clearance distances from the outermost edge of retaining walls to the outside conductor of the overhead electric line are not documented with dimension annotations. The wall plan sheets provide structural details but no clearance dimensions from the OHE line.

details.text: Section exhibits for retaining walls provided (Sheets 38–39) but do not include overhead electric conductor elevations or clearance dimension annotations from outer conductor to wall faces. Sections show structural design but not clearance verification.

runComments.comment: Section exhibits for retaining walls are provided (Sheets 38-39), but these sections do not include overhead electric conductor elevations or clearance dimension annotations from the outer conductor to the wall faces. The sections show structural design but not clearance verification.

details.text: Driveways proposed and shown on site plan and grading plan. Vertical clearances from lowest point of overhead electric line including attachments to finished driveway grade not documented. No section views show mid-span clearance verification for driveways under OHE line.

runComments.comment: Driveways are proposed and shown on site plan and grading plan. However, vertical clearances from the lowest point of the overhead electric line (including any attachments) to the finished driveway grade are not documented. No section views show mid-span clearance verification for driveways under the OHE line.

comments.headline: Transformer pad building clearances not documented
comments.summary: Clearances from transformer pads to buildings, balconies, overhangs, and building openings (windows, doors, ducts) are not dimensioned or verified on the electrical plan. Required Austin Energy Design approvals for reduced clearances are not provided.
comments.crossDep: Austin Energy Design may require written approvals if reduced clearances are proposed.
comments.attn: Equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) must be specified to determine correct clearance requirements. Building elevations must be coordinated with transformer pad locations.

details.text: Clearance dimensions between transformer pads and adjacent buildings are not specified. Compliance with UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4 cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: Transformer pads are shown on the electrical plan but no clearance dimensions are specified between any transformer pad and adjacent buildings. Clearance compliance cannot be verified from the submitted plans.

details.text: Plans do not indicate if reduced 3-foot clearances are proposed for any transformer location. If reduced clearances are used, Austin Energy Design written approval and documentation of required conditions (not in confined space, 10+ ft to windows/doors/ducts, 15+ ft vertical clearance, 3-hour fire rating) are missing.

runComments.comment: Plans do not indicate whether any transformer pads have clearances less than 5 feet to buildings. If reduced clearances (3 feet) are proposed, no Austin Energy Design written approval or documentation of required conditions (not in confined space, 10 ft+ to windows/doors/ducts, 15 ft+ vertical clearance, 3-hour fire rating) is provided.

details.text: Clearances from transformer pads to building balconies and overhangs are not dimensioned or verified. No vertical clearance drawings confirm that pads are not covered by overhead structures and maintain minimum 5-foot lateral clearance from balconies.

runComments.comment: Buildings have balconies and overhangs shown on site plan. No clearance dimensions or vertical clearance drawings verify that transformer pads have minimum 5-foot lateral clearance from balconies and are not covered by overhead structures.

details.text: Equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) is not specified. Clearance from windows/doors/ducts requiring 12-foot horizontal clearance for oil-filled equipment is not documented. No building elevations coordinate with transformer pad locations to verify clearances.

runComments.comment: Clearance from windows/doors/ventilating ducts requires 12-foot horizontal clearance for oil-filled equipment (if window/door/duct is less than 12 feet from grade or has less than 5 feet lateral separation). Equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) is not specified, and no building elevations coordinate with transformer pad locations to verify clearances.

comments.headline: Transformer pad operational space clearances not documented
comments.summary: Hot-stick use areas, confined space clearances, fire escape coordination, and stairwell relationships are not documented on the electrical plan. Required operational clearances cannot be verified.
comments.attn: Access door orientation and hot-stick use area (10-foot minimum from access door) must be clearly marked on electrical plan. Confirm whether any pads are located in confined spaces (niches, vaults, or enclosed areas on 3+ sides).

details.text: Hot-stick use area clearance (minimum 10 feet from access door side) is not documented. Electrical plan shows transformer locations but does not document access door orientation or clearances to open areas or adjacent structures.

runComments.comment: Hot-stick use area clearance (minimum 10 feet from access door side) is a fundamental requirement for all transformer pads. The electrical plan shows transformer locations but does not document access door orientation or clearances to open areas or adjacent structures.

details.text: Increased 15-foot clearance requirement for confined spaces is not addressed. Plans do not identify whether any transformer locations are in confined spaces or provide cross-section drawings demonstrating 15-foot clearance within enclosed areas.

runComments.comment: Increased clearance requirement (15 feet) applies only if transformer location faces confined space (niche, vault, or enclosed area on 3+ sides). Plans do not clearly identify whether any transformer locations are in confined spaces or provide cross-section drawings demonstrating 15-foot clearance within enclosed areas.

details.text: Building floor plans showing stairwell locations have not been reviewed. Relationship between transformer pad locations and any exterior stairwells is not documented on electrical or site plan.

runComments.comment: Building floor plans would show stairwell locations but have not been reviewed. Relationship between transformer pad locations and any exterior stairwells is not documented on the electrical or site plan.

details.text: Fire escape locations (Sheet 10) are not clearly coordinated with transformer pad locations. Equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) is not specified. 20-foot clearance requirement for oil-filled equipment cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: Fire protection plan (Sheet 10) shows fire hydrants but fire escape locations are not clearly coordinated with transformer pad locations on electrical plan. Equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) is not specified. 20-foot clearance requirement for oil-filled equipment cannot be verified.

comments.headline: Overhead distribution clearances and cross-sections not documented
comments.summary: Vertical and horizontal clearances from overhead distribution lines are not dimensioned. Cross-section drawings showing overhead line clearances and customer facilities are missing.
comments.attn: 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance and 15-foot radius clearance (measured from conductors, not pole centerline) are required per UCM § 1.10.3. Cross-section drawings must show vertical clearances in access paths and enclosed areas.

details.text: Overhead distribution lines shown on utility plans lack vertical clearance drawings or dimension callouts verifying minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from overhead conductors at transformer pad locations.

runComments.comment: Overhead distribution lines are shown on utility plans but no vertical clearance drawings or dimension callouts verify the minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from overhead conductors extending from ground to sky at transformer pad locations.

details.text: Overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors shown on electrical plan lack dimension callouts verifying 15-foot radius clearance measured from conductors (not pole centerline) at transformer pad locations.

runComments.comment: Overhead distribution lines are shown on electrical plan but no dimension callouts or measurements verify the 15-foot radius clearance from conductors (measured from conductors, not pole centerline) at transformer pad locations.

details.text: No cross-section drawings are provided showing vertical clearances in access paths, overhead structures, parking garages, or enclosed areas at transformer pad locations. Cross-sections are required to demonstrate hot-stick use area and overhead obstruction compliance.
details.citation: UCM § 1.10.3 (survey requirement as required by AE Design)

runComments.comment: No cross-section drawings are provided showing vertical clearances in access paths, overhead structures, parking garages, or enclosed areas at transformer pad locations. Cross-sections are required to demonstrate vertical clearance compliance, especially for hot-stick use areas and overhead obstructions.

details.text: Overhead distribution facilities shown on utility plans lack cross-section documentation verifying that customer facilities (buildings, parking structures, light poles, signs, antennas, tanks) are not installed under or over overhead lines.

runComments.comment: Overhead distribution facilities are shown on utility plans but cross-section documentation verifying that customer facilities (buildings, parking structures, light poles, signs, antennas, tanks) are not installed under or over these lines is not provided. Coordinate cross-sections or clearance notes are needed.

comments.headline: Transformer pad design specifications and easement documentation incomplete
comments.summary: Transformer pad dimensions, service type, equipment specifications, and location on private property are not documented. Required transformer easements and protective bollards are not shown. Electrical routing and easement conflicts are not verified.
comments.crossDep: Civil/Grading (easement exhibit); Austin Energy Design (pad detail approval)
comments.attn: Transformer pad detail sheets must be obtained from Austin Energy Design. Equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) and service configuration (single-phase vs. three-phase) must be specified to determine pad size and easement requirements. Verify all transformer locations are 100% on private property.

details.text: Transformer pad dimensions and service type are not specified. No dimension callouts show pad sizes, and no references to Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets for specified service type are provided.

runComments.comment: Transformer pad dimensions are NOT specified on the electrical plan. No dimension callouts show pad sizes (e.g., 5'x5', 10'x10', etc.), and no references are provided to Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets for the specified service type (single-phase or three-phase). Service type is not documented. Pad dimensions must be verified against AE Design standards.

details.text: Transformer pads must be located 100% on private property, not in public right-of-way or straddling property lines. Transformer pad locations are not dimensioned or verified relative to property boundary lines on electrical or site plan.

runComments.comment: Requirement that transformer pads be located 100% on private property, not in public right-of-way or straddling property lines, is not explicitly verified on the electrical or site plan. Transformer pad locations relative to property boundary lines are not dimensioned or documented.

details.text: Transformer pads must not be located in prohibited easements (drainage, water, sewer, or electrical easements under overhead lines) without Austin Energy Design approval. Transformer pad locations are shown on electrical plan but NOT shown on grading plan easement exhibit, preventing verification of easement conflicts.

runComments.comment: Transformer pads must not be located in prohibited easements (drainage, water, sewer, or electrical easements under overhead lines) without AE Design written approval. Transformer pad locations are shown on the electrical plan but NOT shown on the grading plan easement exhibit, preventing verification of easement conflicts. Easements are shown on the grading plan but transformer locations are not coordinated with easement boundaries.

details.text: Transformer easements are not shown around any transformer pad locations. While a general note states additional electric easements may be required, preliminary electrical plan does not show transformer-specific easements with widths specified for Austin Energy accessibility requirements.

runComments.comment: Transformer easements are NOT shown around any transformer pad locations. While a note on Sheet 9 states 'Additional electric easements may be required at a later date,' the preliminary electrical plan does not show transformer-specific easements with specified widths for Austin Energy accessibility requirements. Easement boundaries and widths must be documented on the site plan.

details.text: Electrical routing from transformer to meter must be 100% on private property. Electrical plan shows routing paths but does not explicitly verify or document that entire path is on private property, not crossing right-of-way or easements.

runComments.comment: Electrical routing from transformer to meter must be 100% on private property. The electrical plan shows routing paths but does not explicitly verify or document that the entire path is on private property, not crossing right-of-way or easements.

details.text: Transformer pads located within 4 feet of parking aisles or vehicle circulation routes require 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal bollards per Austin Energy Design pad details. No bollard specifications or details are shown on site plan or detail sheets.

runComments.comment: Transformer pads are located within or immediately adjacent to parking areas on the site plan. Where pads are within 4 feet of parking aisles or vehicle circulation routes, 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal bollards are required per AE Design equipment pad details. No bollard specifications or details are shown on the site plan or detail sheets.

details.text: Equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) is not specified on electrical plan. Grading plan shows general surface drainage, but specific documentation that drainage from transformer pad locations slopes away from buildings (required for oil-filled equipment) is not provided.

runComments.comment: Equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) is not specified on the electrical plan. Grading plan shows general surface drainage flowing downhill away from buildings, but specific documentation that drainage from transformer pad locations slopes away from buildings (required for oil-filled equipment) is not provided.

comments.headline: Transformer pad clearances to site elements not verified
comments.summary: Clearances from transformer pads to retaining walls, fences, sidewalks, fire hydrants, dumpsters, bike racks, light poles, fire lanes, and spacing between pads are not dimensioned or coordinated on the electrical and site plans.
comments.crossDep: Fire Department (fire hydrant, fire lanes); Landscape/Site Design (bike racks, dumpster, light poles); Civil/Grading (retaining walls, sidewalks)
comments.attn: Verify exact spacing requirements for each element type with Austin Energy Design. Fire lane clearance (15 feet) differs from other site elements (5 feet).

details.text: Retaining wall locations (Sheet 11) are not clearly coordinated with transformer pad locations (Sheet 21). No clearance dimensions are shown between transformer pads and retaining walls.

runComments.comment: Retaining walls are shown on the grading plan (Sheet 11) but their location relative to transformer pads on Sheet 21 is not clearly coordinated. No clearance dimensions are shown between transformer pads and retaining walls.

details.text: Property boundary fences shown on site plan lack dimension callouts verifying clearance from transformer pads. Required 5 feet for sides with operators/controls, 3 feet for removable ventilated fences cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: Site plan shows property boundary fences but no dimension callouts verify clearance from transformer pads to fences (required 5 feet for sides with operators/controls, 3 feet for other sides with removable ventilated fences).

details.text: Sidewalks near transformer pad locations lack dimension callouts verifying minimum 2-foot clearance from back of sidewalk to pad.

runComments.comment: Site plan shows sidewalks near some transformer pad locations, but no dimension callouts verify the minimum 2-foot clearance from back of sidewalk to transformer pad.

details.text: Private fire hydrant location (Sheet 10) is not coordinated or dimensioned relative to transformer pads on electrical plan. Minimum 5-foot clearance cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: One private fire hydrant is shown on the site plan (Sheet 10). Its location relative to any transformer pads is not coordinated or dimensioned on either the fire protection plan or electrical plan. Minimum 5-foot clearance cannot be verified.

details.text: Dumpster enclosure location shown on site plan is not dimensioned relative to transformer pads. Minimum 5-foot clearance cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: Site plan shows dumpster enclosure location but does not coordinate or dimension clearance from transformer pads. Minimum 5-foot clearance cannot be verified.

details.text: Bike rack locations (41 spaces in parking areas) are not coordinated or dimensioned relative to transformer pads. Minimum 5-foot clearance cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: Site plan shows bike rack locations (41 spaces provided in parking areas) but does not coordinate or dimension clearance from transformer pads. Minimum 5-foot clearance cannot be verified.

details.text: Light pole locations are not documented or coordinated with transformer pad locations. Minimum 5-foot clearance cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: Light pole locations would be shown on photometric/site lighting plan but no coordination is documented with transformer pad locations. Minimum 5-foot clearance cannot be verified.

details.text: Fire lane locations (Sheet 10) are not dimensioned relative to transformer pads on electrical plan. Minimum 15-foot clearance from fire lanes cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: Fire protection plan (Sheet 10) shows fire lanes on site but coordination with transformer pad locations is not dimensioned. Minimum 15-foot clearance from fire lanes cannot be verified.

details.text: Five transformer pads shown on electrical plan lack dimension callouts verifying spacing between pads. Minimum 5-foot clearance between transformer pads cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: Five transformer pads are shown on the electrical plan but no dimension callouts verify spacing between pads. Minimum 5-foot clearance between transformer pads cannot be verified.

comments.headline: Utility line clearances from transformer pads not coordinated
comments.summary: Clearances from transformer pads to water, wastewater, storm sewer, and other underground utilities are not dimensioned. Underground utility cross-section documentation is missing.
comments.crossDep: Water Utility; Wastewater Utility; Stormwater/Watershed Management
comments.attn: 5-foot clearance required from transformer pads to water/wastewater/storm lines per UCM § 2.9.1.B.2. 12-inch horizontal and vertical clearance required from other underground utilities per UCM § 1.10.5.A.

details.text: Water line routing (Sheet 19) is shown but dimension callouts do not verify minimum 5-foot clearance from transformer pads to water service lines.

runComments.comment: Utility plans show water line routing but no dimension callouts verify the minimum 5-foot clearance from transformer pads to water lines.

details.text: Wastewater line routing (Sheet 19) is shown but dimension callouts do not verify minimum 5-foot clearance from transformer pads to wastewater service lines.

runComments.comment: Utility plans show wastewater line routing but no dimension callouts verify the minimum 5-foot clearance from transformer pads to wastewater lines.

details.text: Storm drain line routing (Sheet 12) is shown but dimension callouts do not verify minimum 5-foot clearance from transformer pads to storm drain lines.

runComments.comment: Storm sewer plan (Sheet 12) shows drainage infrastructure but no dimension callouts verify minimum 5-foot clearance from transformer pads to storm drain lines.

details.text: Minimum 12-inch horizontal and vertical clearance from other underground utilities is not dimensioned. No clearance callouts verify this clearance from transformer pads to any underground utilities (power conduits, telecommunications, etc.).

runComments.comment: Minimum 12-inch horizontal and vertical clearance from other underground utilities is a fundamental requirement. No dimension callouts on the electrical plan verify this clearance from transformer pads to any underground utilities (power conduits, telecommunications, etc.).

details.text: Cross-section drawings or coordination notes documenting that transformer pads are not located over/under other utility lines, and that customer buildings are not installed over AE underground facilities, are missing.

runComments.comment: Plans do not clearly document that transformer pads or AE underground facilities are not located over/under other utility lines, or that customer buildings/foundations/structures are not installed over AE underground facilities. Cross-section drawings or detailed coordination notes are needed.

comments.headline: Transformer and utility coordination missing from landscape plan
comments.summary: Landscape plan does not show transformer pad or underground utility locations, preventing verification of tree species utility compatibility, vegetation clearances, and root barrier requirements.
comments.crossDep: Landscape Architecture; City Arborist (tree species, root barriers)
comments.attn: Landscape plan (Sheet 31) must overlay transformer pad and underground utility locations (from electrical plan Sheet 21) to verify compatibility. Tree species list (Sheet 32) must cross-reference ECM Appendix F utility-compatible designation.

details.text: Landscape plan does not show transformer pad locations, preventing verification of tree species utility-compatibility within 10 feet of pads or 15 feet of overhead distribution conductors. Tree species list does not cross-reference ECM Appendix F utility-compatible designation.

runComments.comment: Landscape plan (Sheet 31) does not show transformer pad locations, preventing verification of tree species utility-compatibility within 10 feet of pads or 15 feet of overhead distribution conductors. Tree species list (Sheet 32) does not cross-reference ECM Appendix F utility-compatible designation.

details.text: Landscape plan does not show transformer pad locations, preventing verification that shrubs and low-lying vegetation maintain minimum 10 feet clearance from transformer access door sides and 5 feet clearance from other sides.

runComments.comment: Landscape plan does not show transformer pad locations, preventing verification that shrubs and low-lying vegetation maintain minimum 10 feet clearance from transformer access door sides and 5 feet clearance from other sides.

comments.headline: Boundary and perimeter feature clearances not verified
comments.summary: Fences, sidewalks, streetlight pole setbacks, and down guy wire locations and easements lack clearance documentation and proximity verification. No dimension annotations confirm alignments relative to overhead electric conductors, poles, or property limits.
comments.crossDep: Coordinate with Public Works (sidewalks, streetlight poles on Valley View Road); coordinate with Utility company (existing pole locations, down guy wire infrastructure, relocation or retention decisions).
comments.attn: Existing utility poles shown on existing conditions survey (Sheet 4) but specific locations not integrated into site plan. Clarify whether existing poles will be relocated, remain in place, or be converted to self-supporting. Document down guy wire locations, anchor points, and easement boundaries if poles remain.

details.text: Fence alignments and clearance distances from overhead electric conductors cannot be verified. While site plan includes 'Fence Note' regarding hand-digging in Critical Root Zones, no clearance dimensions shown between fence alignments and conductor positions.

runComments.comment: Fence alignments and clearance distances from overhead electric conductors cannot be verified. While the site plan includes a 'Fence Note' regarding hand-digging requirements in Critical Root Zones, no clearance dimensions are shown between fence alignments and overhead electric conductor positions.

details.text: Sidewalks proposed along property frontage on site plan. Existing power poles present along Valley View Road per existing conditions survey. Alignments of proposed sidewalks relative to existing pole locations at property limits not documented with dimension annotations.

runComments.comment: Sidewalks are proposed along the property frontage (shown on site plan). Existing power poles are present along Valley View Road (west property line) per the existing conditions survey. However, the specific alignments of proposed sidewalks relative to the existing pole locations at property limits are not documented with dimension annotations or detailed clearance verifications.

details.text: Existing streetlight poles likely present along Valley View Road per existing conditions survey showing utility poles along road frontage. Clearances from proposed buildings to existing streetlight pole locations not documented with dimension annotations or setback verification.

runComments.comment: Existing streetlight poles are likely present along Valley View Road per the existing conditions survey, which shows utility poles along the road frontage. However, clearances from proposed buildings to existing streetlight pole locations are not documented with dimension annotations or setback verification.

details.text: Down guy wires supporting poles may exist given utility poles shown on existing conditions survey and site plan. Specific down guy wire locations (anchor points and cable routing) not explicitly depicted or detailed on plans. No relocation notes or conversion-to-self-supporting-pole specifications provided.

runComments.comment: Down guy wires supporting poles may exist or be implied from the utility poles shown on the existing conditions survey and site plan. However, specific down guy wire locations (anchor points and cable routing) are not explicitly depicted or detailed on the plans. No relocation notes or conversion-to-self-supporting-pole specifications are provided. The grouping guide acknowledges that 'electric utility infrastructure is frequently omitted from plans,' making verification difficult. Applicability cannot be determined without explicit down guy wire depiction.

details.text: Down guy anchor easements (10 feet wide extending 5 feet past ground entry) not explicitly depicted or documented on plat or site plan. Existing utility poles shown on survey may have down guys, but specific anchor locations and dedicated easement boundaries not identified.

Existing utility poles shown on the survey may have down guys, but the specific anchor locations and dedicated easement boundaries are not identified.

comments.headline: Electric easement compliance and ancillary feature clearances unverified
comments.summary: Utility easement boundaries and usage restrictions are not clearly documented. Proposed site features within easements lack verification that facilities are not prohibited and maintain required minimum clearances. Tree species identification and decorative lighting locations are incomplete.
comments.crossDep: Coordinate with Utility company (easement boundaries, facility prohibitions, easement survey); coordinate with Landscape Architecture (tree species selection and utility-compatible plants compliance); coordinate with Architecture (decorative lighting fixture locations).
comments.attn: UCM § 1.10.3 absolutely prohibits customer facilities under or over Austin Energy overhead distribution facilities, independent of clearance distances. Verify easement boundaries against property survey. Landscape plan tree schedule must cross-reference ECM Appendix F Utility Compatible trees list by species name.

details.text: Electric easements (5' and 15' marked on site plan) shown but code prohibits installing customer facilities under or over Austin Energy overhead distribution facilities. Items within easements must maintain minimum 7.5-foot clearance from outside conductor. Without detailed easement boundary documentation and clearance dimension annotations, compliance cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: Electric easements (5' and 15' marked on site plan) are shown on the site plan. The code absolutely prohibits installing customer facilities under or over Austin Energy overhead distribution facilities, independent of clearance distances. Additionally, items within electric easements must maintain minimum 7.5-foot clearance from outside conductor. Without detailed easement boundary documentation and clearance dimension annotations from conductors, compliance cannot be verified.

details.text: Decorative lighting referenced in site plan notes (exterior lighting must be full cut-off and fully-shielded per Subchapter E 2.5, reviewed at building plan stage). Specific decorative lighting fixture locations and their clearances from OHE line not documented with clearance verification dimensions.

runComments.comment: Decorative lighting is referenced in the site plan notes (exterior lighting must be full cut-off and fully-shielded per Subchapter E 2.5, reviewed at building plan stage). However, specific decorative lighting fixture locations and their clearances from the OHE line are not documented with clearance verification dimensions.

details.text: Landscape plan shows trees (existing and mitigation) near OHE line on south property boundary. Lateral distance from tree symbols to conductor line cannot be confirmed as within 10-foot lateral clearance requirement. Tree species identification limited to general categories (SY, PL, P, M) which cannot be cross-referenced against ECM Appendix F Utility Compatible trees list. Utility-compatible species compliance cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: Landscape plan shows trees (existing and mitigation trees) near the OHE line on the south property boundary. However, the lateral distance from specific tree symbols to the OHE conductor line cannot be confirmed as within or outside the 10-foot lateral clearance requirement for distribution conductors. Tree species identification on the landscape plan is limited to general categories (SY=Street Yard, PL=Parking Lot, P=existing trees, M=Mitigation), which cannot be cross-referenced against ECM Appendix F Utility Compatible trees list without detailed plant schedule. Applicability of utility-compatible species restrictions cannot be verified.

comments.headline: Overhead line trees lack species, height, clearance details
comments.summary: Proposed trees near the overhead electric line lack species identification, mature height designation, and clearance dimensions from both the conductor and utility poles. This prevents verification of utility compatibility, code-required clearances, and Austin Energy approval requirements.

details.text: Proposed trees marked as 'M' (Mitigation Trees) on Landscape Plan are not identified by species. Cannot verify whether non-utility-compatible trees are proposed within 15 lateral feet of conductor.

runComments.comment: Proposed trees (labeled 'M' - Mitigation Trees) are shown near the overhead electric line on the Landscape Plan, but their species are not identified on this sheet. details.text: Proposed trees near overhead electric line are not differentiated by mature height or size on Landscape Plan. Cannot verify whether large trees (40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) are proposed within 25 lateral feet of the distribution conductor.

details.text: Utility poles marked with 'x' symbols on Landscape Plan along the overhead electric line have no clearance dimensions to proposed tree locations. Cannot verify that all trees maintain required 10-foot lateral clearance from poles.

runComments.comment: Utility poles are shown on the Landscape Plan (marked with 'x' symbols along the OHE line), and proposed trees are depicted throughout the plan. However, no clearance dimensions or measurements are provided between pole locations and tree locations. Cannot verify that all trees maintain the required 10-foot lateral clearance from poles.

details.text: Proposed trees near overhead electric line are shown only with letter 'M' designation without species names on Landscape Plan Sheet 31. Plant schedule on Sheet 35 does not cross-reference locations relative to utilities, violating drawing convention.

runComments.comment: Proposed trees on the Landscape Plan that are located near the overhead electric line are identified only by the letter 'M' (Mitigation Tree) with no species names or common names provided on Sheet 31. The plant schedule on Sheet 35 lists proposed species but does not cross-reference their locations relative to utilities. Species identification is required on the Landscape Plan for trees near electric facilities to verify compliance with utility compatibility requirements.

details.text: All proposed trees on Landscape Plan shown with identical symbol regardless of mature height. Large trees (40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) are not visually or textually differentiated from smaller trees, preventing verification of overhead clearance compliance.

runComments.comment: Large trees proposed on the Landscape Plan are not differentiated from smaller trees by size, caliper, mature height, or any visual or textual designation. All mitigation and proposed trees are shown with the same symbol regardless of their mature height. Differentiation is required to allow reviewers to verify that large trees (40+ feet mature height per ECM Appendix F) comply with clearance restrictions from overhead electric facilities.

details.text: No tree clearance measurements or dimensions are shown on Landscape Plan between proposed trees and overhead electric line. Measurement methodology (pole centerline vs. conductor, trunk center vs. canopy edge) cannot be assessed due to absence of dimensions.

runComments.comment: No tree clearance measurements or dimensions are shown on the Landscape Plan between proposed trees and the overhead electric line. Therefore, the measurement methodology (whether measured from pole centerline vs. conductor, or from trunk center vs. canopy edge) cannot be assessed. This item is not verifiable due to absence of measurements rather than incorrect measurement methodology.

details.text: No tree clearance dimensions on Landscape Plan prevent evaluation of whether measurements reference tree trunk center or canopy edge. Item is not verifiable due to absence of measurements.

runComments.comment: No tree clearance measurements are dimensioned on the Landscape Plan, so the measurement reference point (tree trunk center vs. canopy edge) cannot be evaluated. This checklist item cannot be verified due to the absence of measurements rather than incorrect methodology.

details.text: Without species identification and clearance dimensions on Landscape Plan, cannot determine whether proposed trees are within prohibited clearance zones from overhead line. Austin Energy written approval for variations, if required, cannot be verified or documented.

runComments.comment: Without species identification for trees on the Landscape Plan and without clearance dimensions, it cannot be determined whether any proposed trees are within prohibited clearance zones. Therefore, the presence or absence of Austin Energy written approval for variations cannot be assessed. If trees are determined to be within restricted zones, such approval would be required and must be documented on the plans.

comments.headline: Underground equipment trees lack clearance and barrier details
comments.summary: Proposed trees near underground electrical equipment (transformers and pull boxes shown on Sheet 21) lack clearance dimensions on the Landscape Plan and have no root barrier specifications. Cannot verify required clearances and root protection in the 20-foot utility equipment zone.
comments.crossDep: Utility department (cross-sheet equipment coordination); Landscape architect (plan coordination)

details.text: Electrical Design Plan (Sheet 21) shows underground equipment (transformers and pull boxes), but relationship to proposed tree locations on Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) is not clearly depicted. No clearance dimensions provided between equipment and tree locations.
